title: 🤖 Эко-активист: поговори с AI-ботом
description: Поговори с 14-летним эко-активистом и школьным журналистом. Обсуди привычки, текущие проекты, планы и то, что вас раздражает — используй Present Continuous!

sections.name: ⚡ Действие прямо сейчас (Action now)
questions: What are you doing right now?
Are you listening to music at the moment?
Is anyone in your family using the computer right now?

sections.name: 🏕️ Временная ситуация (Temporary)
questions: Are you working on any school project these days?
Are you reading any interesting books at the moment?
Are you staying at home today?

sections.name: 🔄 Тенденции и перемены (Trends)
questions: How is our planet changing right now?
Do you think technology is getting too fast?

sections.name: 📅 Планы на будущее (Future arrangements)
questions: What are you doing this weekend?
Are you meeting your friends tomorrow?
Where are you going for your summer holidays?

sections.name: 😡 Раздражение (Irritation with always)
questions: What is one thing your friend is always doing that annoys you?
Is your sibling always taking your things?
What are you constantly complaining about at school?
